services.title: Diagnostics and check engine work
services.body: The fault gets traced to its actual cause before anything is replaced, so you pay for the part that failed and not the three beside it.

evidence.text: HMI took care of my car and helped me diagnose the engine code I was getting.
evidence.also: They diagnosed and fixed the issues quickly and at a great price.

services.title: Engine repair
services.body: The engine comes apart far enough to find the actual fault, not far enough to run up the bill.

evidence.text: HMI took care of my car and helped me diagnose the engine code I was getting.
evidence.also: Had the timing belt and the external belts replaced.

services.title: Steering, suspension and alignment
services.body: Worn steering and suspension parts come off, the replacement goes on beside them, and the alignment is set on the rack afterwards.

reviews.author: Shari Stess-Scott
reviews.text: Sean and Baron are the absolute best guys. The folks at HMI treat me like family. All my car needs are always taken care of with the utmost professionalism and personal care. Actually all the technicians are absolutely fabulous to deal with. I highly recommend HMI Auto Care to everyone. Service always with a smile and a kind word. I am A long time customer and wouldn't go anywhere else. Fondly Yours Shari Stess-Scott

reviews.author: Harry Cibak
reviews.text: We've been going to HMI for over 15 years and while they have always been great...they keep getting better. Still straight forward honest evaluations with reasonably priced work. In my most recent visit, HMI provided a comprehensive report (with pictures) on my vehicle. Enormously informative and very helpful for me to understand my vehicle's condition and plan my future maintenance needs. Professional, competent, friendly and fairly priced...none better.

reviews.author: Emily Costigan
reviews.text: Amazing service! Wonderful staff that will not rip you off at all. Below average prices and great service, I cannot recommend this place enough! I have been going them for multiple years now and I will continue for the future.

reviews.author: Lawrence Paulauskas
reviews.text: we have been coming to HMI Auto Care for years and the service has always been consistent on several vehicles we have owned. It is fantastic this local shop has Road Force Balancing equipment which is the best method for balancing tires. Trustworthy service.

reviews.author: Edward Domanico
reviews.text: As usual the service on my Honda was conducted efficiently and thoroughly…the service particulars were discussed with me prior to the work. Additionally suggestions were discussed with me during service asking whether maintenance options should be implemented. Special thanks to Sean, Baron and Vaughan for keeping my vehicle in excellent working order.

reviews.author: David Artis
reviews.text: Trusted my Mercedes c43 repairs to HMI Auto Care rather than over paying at the dealership. They diagnosed and fixed the issues quickly and at a great price. Excellent service!!

reviews.author: Judy DeMaris
reviews.text: I would definitely recommend coming to this business to service your car. Everyone is friendly and they keep you updated on how the servicing is going. I feel they are very honest and trustworthy.

reviews.author: Big Buck
reviews.text: Had 4 new tires mounted on my car. I was impressed that HMI could have charged me for a wheel alignment but the car was inspec after tires were mounted. And HMI told me they didn't need to do the alignment. That was very honest of them. Also like that they did mulipoint inspection of car. And tested battery free of charge

reviews.author: John Walsh
reviews.text: Continues to be my go to for all my automotive needs. Great service all around, very professional, and the work is top notch. Very reasonable, honest, and conducts business with a great deal of integrity. I have referred family and friends and they have also been impressed. I am VERY happy to have found this establishment. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Gene Victori
reviews.text: This shop cannot be trusted to do a job right the the 1st time. They charge top dollar but their work will have to be repeated in 3 to 4 years.... conveniently when is is out of their warranty period

reviews.author: George
reviews.text: I usually don’t write reviews but it’s HMI. I’ve been going to them for almost 15 years and that should be a testament in itself. The HMI team bends over backwards to take care of you. I definitely recommend giving them a try.

reviews.author: Louis Toscano
reviews.text: What can I say? Since buying my car, I had to go to somebody that my warranty required. When warning lights go on, I have to have them checked out. I would rather deal with them than with police during a pullover. After they did their work, I learned how to do a few things myself.

reviews.author: Timothy Rowe
reviews.text: Thank you for a speedy service visit and access to a loaner vehicle so I could knock out a few errands. Great work, HMI! See you next time.

reviews.author: William Steinle
reviews.text: Provided excellent service at a fair price. Gave a detailed report on what was needed and options available. Car was completed before the time requested.

reviews.author: Mary Elwell
reviews.text: Been taking my cars here for 25 years and would not go anywhere else! Baron and staff are courteous and efficient and the repair pricing is fair.

reviews.author: Christopher Bry-Nildsen
reviews.text: New customer to HMI (but sold them auto parts for years when I worked for Toyota). Very pleased with the repairs to my old Volvo.Will be back again.

reviews.author: Tom Casciano
reviews.text: Great place to get your car fixed ! Very knowledgeable and friendly people. They stand behind their work Very fair and honest prices

reviews.author: Thomas Evans
reviews.text: Though my repairs were expensive, I cannot fault HMI on their thoroughness. And unlike some shops, Barron and the people working on my car kept me informed every step of the way: what was needed, how much it would cost, how long it would take, etc.

reviews.author: Jason Zacchia
reviews.text: Baron and the team always doing a great job. Pleasant surprise to find out it was not a major issue - they are always fair and honest.

reviews.author: Dick Millar
reviews.text: HMI has been our ‘go to’ place for the service of our Audis! Thorough, fair, and pleasant to deal with!

reviews.author: Stephen Ochieng
reviews.text: These guys are just friendly ,professional and really fair with their prices and honest! I'll always come here.

reviews.author: Peter Anderson
reviews.text: These guys are the real deal. Been to many other shops and just got the runaround. They took care of my wife very fairly without bending her over a barrel and showing her the 50 states. It’s nice to see a shop not take advantage of women. So many do but not Sean and his team! Thanks guys!!!!

reviews.author: Donna Fugaro
reviews.text: HMI is the only place we takeout cars! They do great work, and are always fast, honest and accommodating.

reviews.author: Eelnah Rami
reviews.text: James at the Hackettstown Avis location was absolutely amazing! When we found out we couldn’t fly because we didn’t have our REAL IDs, we had to pivot quickly and take a road trip instead. We needed a van last minute, and James went above and beyond to help us out. His professionalism, kindness, and calm demeanor made a stressful situation so much easier. We even forgot my son's phone in the van, and thanks to James’s honesty and attentiveness, we were able to pick it up the next day without any hassle. It’s rare to find someone so genuinely helpful and dedicated to outstanding customer service. We’ll definitely be renting from Avis again, because of you, James!

reviews.author: Scott Waleck
reviews.text: There's a reason HMI has good reviews.. they earn them! Amazing customer service and communication. I had my truck in for brakes and a Trans service. They called not once but twice to discuss the transmisson service and then the status of my brakes. Super honest and quality workmanship. Very fair pricing. They will definitely have a repeat customer in me. Thank you HMI!

reviews.author: Renee Snyder
reviews.text: Always do a great job no matter what the issue is, honest, fair and kind service from everyone I've dealt with. The receptionist is awesome, she is well spoken, great personality and always gets me in quickly! I'd recommend this place for any car needs u may have.

reviews.author: Nancy Ginsberg
reviews.text: I had an issue with a car battery in my mercedes sl 550 and Sean at HMI really stepped up and did the right thing when he really didnt have to. I so appreciated what they did.

reviews.author: Andrew Camporini
reviews.text: A+++. Totally understood my needs to get my car to pass inspection and gave me great options to accomplish that goal. From the office contact to the mechanic who performed the work, everyone was kind and polite. Great job and super affordable too.

reviews.author: Mia Malia On Air
reviews.text: In 2010 I was a broke 18 year old freshman at Centenary and working full time at Sears in Rockaway Mall in the evenings (making $7 an hour). My first car was a lemon and I remember taking it to this repair shop at least one or twice a month before it finally died. I would ask them to just diagnose the issue but not repair it because I didn’t have the money to have it fixed. Just about every time they would repair my car for me free of charge. One time it needed serious work and they only charged me $100 (I’m sure the labor was worth much more than that). 13 years later and I still remember your kindness and generosity. These were the most caring and HONEST mechanics I’ve ever come across in my life! I’ve since moved to Europe but I’m glad to see you’re still in business and doing well. May God continue to bless you!

reviews.author: Gregory Costrini
reviews.text: We recently moved to this area. I've used the same mechanic to repair my cars for the past 25+ years. I was happy to find this shop with a good rating. Thanks to the folks for posting reviews. Here's my two cents...... This was a specialized repair for an oil leak and Ray immediately diagnosed the problem and called me later with a repair estimate. He also said he had the parts available - not my usual experience. We scheduled the repair and it was done the the same day as he said. The final repair cost was significantly LESS than the estimate! I can't recall ever having that experience. Not only honest but a testament to the mechanics abilities to make the repair in short time. There is a rental car business in the same building and the daily rental fee is very reasonable. Very convenient. I can't say I like spending money on car repairs but dealing with nice, capable and honest people makes it far less painful.

reviews.author: Joshua Danziger
reviews.text: I brought an exhaust pipe to get a new flange welded in place. I showed up on a Friday morning and even though they were busy, they made sure to help me out and got the work done in record time and at a great price. This is the only shop around that will do exhaust repair work the proper way. Most shops would just have me pay a lot more money and replace the whole part when just the flange is bad. So very pleased with this experience and I will very much use them again!

reviews.author: Doug
reviews.text: Very friendly! Very nice people and very honest. I lifted the car up when I got home to check out the work and they did a fantastic job! Much cheaper than what other places quoted me too. Great to finally find a shop that is honest and does great work!

reviews.author: David Onorevole
reviews.text: HMI took care of my car and helped me diagnose the engine code I was getting. Only comment I have is it would be nice to receive a discount on the diagnostic fee since I got the work done there. Other than that they are going to take care of you and your car.

reviews.author: Jacqlyn Olecki
reviews.text: Great experience! I went in this week to get an estimate on a repair. The price they gave was very fair and they were able to fix it on the spot. I was driving my repaired car within the hour! I will definitely be returning for any repairs I need as well as recommending this place to friends!

reviews.author: James DiRenzo
reviews.text: I have been an HMI customer for more than 20 years. During that time I have always been confident that the repairs and maintenance done to my cars were done efficiently, with expert mechanics using the best parts. My wife and I put on a lot of miles and when we are making a trip I am sure that my vehicle has been given the very best treatment and that it would get us there and back safely. A few years ago I swapped my car with my son. He drove it for two years and then sold it. The buyer called me to say that he had never seen such a comprehensive record of a vehicles maintenance. That is a very strong point at HMI.

reviews.author: Jay Cazes
reviews.text: Ray and Barron have been absolutely amazing! Time and time again they have rescued my vehicles, offering great service, quick turnarounds and extremely fair pricing.

reviews.author: Harry Cibak
reviews.text: Have been going to HMI for many years (10 plus). Today I'm getting an oil change, a wheel stud repaired and a downpipe installed on my truck...Yes, today, and I'm so confident that they will once again do their extraordinary work at a fair price that I'm rating them 5 Stars before the work even begins...it's that kind of place that instills that kind of confidence. People you can trust!

reviews.author: Ethan Dever
reviews.text: The owners of this shop are the kindest, most hospitable and trusting I have met. My car broke down in front of their lot after hours and I was lucky enough that they were still there. The owner helped me diagnose the vehicle, tried charging the battery repeatedly and came to the realization that it was an alternator that needed replacement. They ordered the parts after hours, fixed the vehicle by the next morning (on a day the shop was closed) and charged me less than I would have anywhere else. Where most businesses today would charge more for that type of service because the consumer has no choice or simply refuse it - they did the opposite. They also completed a full inspection on the vehicle and pointed out things that were not up to par. These were things that my local shop overlooks (or simply ignores) to get me in and out. If you are looking for a true mechanic that will keep your car running and safe, while still charging less than alternative big name brand shops - this is your new shop! PS- When you know that they do it because they love it, that’s who I want to go to for service. I like to stay away from the guys just punching in and out.

reviews.author: Joseph Clarke
reviews.text: Ray and team Ray has assembled over the years do reliable work, having your vehicle serviced can be a very stressful experience however I've found HMI to be a credible automotive repair business. I'd would never take a exhaust related issue anywhere else, his exhaust specialist is second to non be it a classic car or late mode.

reviews.author: Zachary Cioletti
reviews.text: I had a custom catback exhaust installed a while back, and they did a great job! The staff was polite and professional and they are very organized. A great place if you need your car serviced or fixed.

reviews.author: Bill Venetis
reviews.text: I took a BMW X5 to Hmi and they totally took advantage of me. When the battery goes low on a BMW the 4 x 4 light comes on. All you have to do is turn the wheel to the left enter the right and it will go off. Hmi told me that they replace the 4 x 4 and 1 million other things on the car when they only repaired a few things. I only took the car there for them to look it over and I left there with a $5000 bill over $5000. Don’t trust the baron or their shop. I really hope that they do not do this to all of their customers. Find a different mechanic

reviews.author: Paintpourri
reviews.text: We take all of our vehicles here for service and repairs and have been very satisfied with their services. They do NOT try to push other unnecessary maintenance on you like a lot of other places do. Very courteous, clean and their pricing is excellent. Would highly recommend. Sue Lane

reviews.author: Robert Stulack II
reviews.text: This is the second time that HMI put an exhaust on my '95 Grand Cherokee that runs like a champ. I'm just as happy with their work as the first time!!! They do great work and I drove the whole way home with the window open and a smile on my face listening to the lovely rumble of my new exhaust. Thanks HMI for doing another great job!!!!

reviews.author: Trevor Williams
reviews.text: Had glasspacks installed on my Crown Vic Police Interceptor. Staff was friendly, provided the exact information on how the install would go, and at a great price. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: T.K. Ammons
reviews.text: Great people! Kind, friendly, & courteous! Mechanic (Baron) took the time to explain (in layman's terms, to a woman) what was to be done & didn't seem exasperated or perturbed having to do it. Thanks guys! Keep up the good work. 1 minor detail...I usually ask beforehand (to see the parts that come off my car) & forgot to this time. Would be nice if the mechanics offered or asked their customers if they'd like to see the old parts (at least on major repairs) before they're tossed. Just a suggestion. All-in-all, still a great job!

reviews.author: Dennis Carney
reviews.text: A Reputable Honest Shop which is an Oasis in the questionable practices a lot of the quick shops use to RIP off unsuspecting customers...This is quite refreshing as after 35 years that I spent in the Automotive Industry exceeds all expectations. You have my permission to use my survey as I am only suggesting your shop to anyone that asks me about great auto repairs.

reviews.author: Walt Godek
reviews.text: First time customer for A/C compressor replace and system check. Professional service all the way. Reasonable price. car - 2007 Acura T/L Recommend and will definitely be back.

reviews.author: William S
reviews.text: Baron and the folks at HMI are great. Never have overcharged for a repair and always work around your schedule. Solid quality repairs. Highest recommendation.

reviews.author: Chris Hayden
reviews.text: I feel as though the work on my 1964 Ford pick up was well done. The owner and his staff were knowledgeable, polite, and honest.

reviews.author: Anthony Thomas
reviews.text: Great place. Only had some tires mounted and balanced but did an excellent job. Kinda particular for my 911 Turbo. Highly Recommended!

reviews.author: Brian Gutschmidt
reviews.text: Super professional they did a great job with my car. Would recommend for everyone to bring their vehicle here

reviews.author: David C
reviews.text: Great service, reasonably priced. Saved me loads of $$ repairing exhaust rather than Audi replacing whole system.

reviews.author: Joseph Nesbihal
reviews.text: Very friendly service. My truck was ready when promised, and the work needed was completed. Very happy with HMI.

reviews.author: NetDynamic _
reviews.text: Went here two different occasions to get an estimate. Always the very highest price and their upsell is ridiculous. I think these other reviewers are either fake or misinformed.

reviews.author: Steve Lascari
reviews.text: Very pleased with the service. Had the timing belt and the external belts replaced. Also water pump and tensioner replaced.

reviews.author: francis apor
reviews.text: This place is run very professionally. Reminds me of a car dealer service center..... but without the high prices.

reviews.author: Pete Sklannik
reviews.text: Outstanding service and reasonable prices. Highly recommend for all types of vehicles needing service.

reviews.author: Anna
reviews.text: I brought a car in to have it checked for potential purchase. They were so thorough; we were very happy.
